title: Obsidian Skull

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Grants the ability to walk on lava and a 45 second heat resistance

body:
"Forged from the depths of below, this skull holds the darkest of sins, and grants the ability to walk on lava"

Description

The Obsidian Skull is available for purchase at the Magma Cave Shop situated within the depths of the Magma Caves, priced at $200,000. When equipped, it grants the player the ability to walk on lava with a 45 second heat resistance. It also grants the ability to drive a car on lava, though this is substantially less useful as the car will immediately sink if the player exits.

Appearance

When equipped, the Obsidian Skull shows as a belt around the players waist with a skull serving as its buckle. The bands of the belt is metal, along with fire esc ornaments positioned on either side of the skull.

Trivia

  • While wearing the Obsidian Skull, the player will hear an evil laugh while loading their save.
  • The Obsidian Skull is the fourth most expensive item, after Flamethrower, Nuclear Warhead and Glass ducky.
